title: FaultDx FHKB Validation Policy
description: Defines whether an FHKB case package or case record is accepted as a candidate reference, held for review, or rejected.

rejection_conditions: source is unnamed or not registered in the governed source boundary
producer scans an aggregate directory instead of consuming a named artifact
missing canonical case identity or record-level source references
case_id does not match the governed source identity tuple
serving_safe is not true at package level
no allowed serving-safe retrieval text is present
record claims reviewed or confirmed diagnosis
record attempts to create or promote a MappingRecord
candidate_review_conditions: case identity collides with non-equivalent content
sensitive free text requires domain review

migration: Keep route_c_source_boundary_v1 active until this policy is frozen and runtime adoption is approved.
Register each FHKB source explicitly; never replace registration with a wildcard or directory scan.
Add producer-side package validation before the existing Route C projection.
Run consumer validation with the existing rag_case_pool to case_retrieval mapping.
Bind runtime only after affected-consumer approval.
compatibility.rollback: Continue using the named sources and projection rules in route_c_source_boundary_v1 until the FHKB pair is reviewed and accepted.
